_about: Which club this save manages. The analysis scripts and skills read this.
_save_pattern: Glob for the save in the FM26 games folder; 'latest' picks the newest match. Name saves after the experiment (e.g. claude-1.fm) and set e.g. "claude-*.fm".
goal: Moneyball: generate transfer profit while competing; buy output the market underprices, sell what it overprices.
_mode: How Claude judges players: "ability" (FM's hidden CA/PA) or "moneyball" (only what a manager sees: attributes, stats, value, age). See analysis/quality.py.
